# ajairu

> Bespoke software development for UK small and medium businesses (10-250 employees). We build custom platforms, connect systems, and replace expensive SaaS subscriptions with software you own outright.

## What We Do

ajairu is a UK-based bespoke software development studio founded by Toby Callinan, former CTO at Fabric Fintech (acquired by Aviva). With 27+ years in software engineering, we deliver enterprise-grade bespoke software at SME-appropriate pricing.

Our approach: discover first, design second, build third, hand over everything. We tell you when bespoke software will help and when off-the-shelf is the better answer. Every engagement is fixed-price. You own the source code.

## Services

- **System Integration & Automation** (£8,000-£30,000, 4-8 weeks): Custom API integrations between CRM, accounting, ERP, e-commerce, and job management systems. Automated data sync and AI-powered workflows.
  - [System Integration UK](/services/system-integration-uk)
- **Bespoke Software Platform** (£25,000-£80,000+, 8-16 weeks): Custom platform built around your exact business processes. Web, mobile, and API development. Cloud-native architecture. You own the source code.
- **SaaS / ERP Replacement** (£30,000-£80,000+, 12-20 weeks): Replace expensive SaaS subscriptions with bespoke software you own outright. Data migration, team training, and zero vendor lock-in.
  - [ERP Replacement UK](/services/erp-replacement-uk)
- **AI Automation** (£8,000-£30,000, 4-8 weeks): AI-powered automation workflows built into your custom software - eliminating manual tasks and improving data quality.
  - [AI Automation UK](/services/ai-automation-uk)
- **Technical Consultancy** (£2,000-£10,000, 1-3 weeks): Architecture review, tech stack selection, build-vs-buy analysis, and technical due diligence.
- **Ongoing Support** (from £350/month): Monitoring, maintenance, updates, and enhancements for software we have built or inherited.

## Key Differentiators

- Enterprise experience: Delivered Aviva's first customer-facing generative AI product, led 45-person team, Tech of the Year 2024, Pension Innovation Award 2024.
- Fixed-price engagements only. No day rates, no open-ended billing.
- AI-accelerated development: 60-70% lower build costs, 8-16 week delivery timelines.
- Full ownership: source code, documentation, training. Your team owns everything.
- UK GDPR compliant, security best practices built in.
- We tell you when off-the-shelf software is the better answer.

## Target Clients

UK businesses with 10-250 employees across: manufacturing, accountants, e-commerce, healthcare, financial services, real estate, logistics, construction, hospitality, law firms, education, and marketing agencies.

## Founder

Toby Callinan, CTO at Fabric Fintech (acquired by Aviva late 2023). 27+ years in software engineering. Delivered Aviva's first customer-facing generative AI product, Tech of the Year 2024. Based in the UK, working nationwide.
